requirements.title: Authentication and session
requirements.description: Users must sign in before using the shop. Only the login page, the help page and the health check are available without signing in; any other page redirects to the login page.
requirements.source_quote: Users must sign in before using the shop. Only the login page, the help page and the health check are available without signing in; any other page redirects to the login page.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Given valid credentials (for example `alice` / `alice-pass-1`), when the user submits the login form, then they land on the Products page.
acceptance_criteria.source_quote: Given valid credentials (for example `alice` / `alice-pass-1`), when the user submits the login form, then they land on the Products page.
acceptance_criteria.testability_reason: Verifiable in the web UI by submitting valid credentials.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Given a wrong password or an unknown username, when the user submits the login form, then the page shows exactly "Invalid username or password" and does not reveal which part was wrong.

acceptance_criteria.testability_reason: Verifiable in the web UI by attempting login with invalid username or password.

acceptance_criteria.statement: When the user logs out, the session is invalidated on the server: afterwards every protected page redirects to the login page, even if the old session cookie is sent again.
acceptance_criteria.source_quote: When the user logs out, the session is invalidated on the server: afterwards every protected page redirects to the login page, even if the old session cookie is sent again.
acceptance_criteria.testability_reason: Verifiable by logging out and attempting to access protected pages with the original session cookie.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Every field on the login form (Username, Password) has a visible label that is programmatically associated with its input (accessible name).
acceptance_criteria.source_quote: Every field on the login form (Username, Password) has a visible label that is programmatically associated with its input (accessible name).
acceptance_criteria.testability_reason: Accessibility standard requirement checking programmatic DOM associations for labels.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Only the login page, the help page and the health check are available without signing in; any other page redirects to the login page.
acceptance_criteria.source_quote: Only the login page, the help page and the health check are available without signing in; any other page redirects to the login page.
acceptance_criteria.testability_reason: Verifiable by navigating to protected UI routes without an active session.

acceptance_criteria.statement: All API endpoints except `/api/health` require a signed-in session (otherwise HTTP 401).
acceptance_criteria.source_quote: All API endpoints except `/api/health` require a signed-in session (otherwise HTTP 401).
acceptance_criteria.testability_reason: Verifiable by issuing unauthenticated HTTP requests to API endpoints.
